doc.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006

title: Closing thanks and the straw hats rebellion begins
summary: Final thanks, then Sherman raises the band's resistance to wearing straw hats.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Anything you want to add before we head on to your dinner and so forth?
No, I’d like to add nothing except thanks to you and for what you’re doing for the college, the Jazz Archive deserves everybody’s support.
Great. Appreciate it. And I look forward to playing with you this weekend.
Hey good. We won’t forget that. We are going to hold you to that.
One of these days I’m going to get one of those straw hats. I don’t know how many years I have to put in but —
Uh, is the interview over now?
I don’t know, we could still be rolling.
It doesn’t make any difference. I’m having a minor rebellion by the band.
